text: [94] pañcime bhikkhave phāsuvihārā katame pañca idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi .pe. paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā .pe. dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati #1 ma. yu. rajanīyo . 2 ma. kuhakāssaddhaakkhamā . 3 po. aññabyākaraṇāni . pītiyā ca virāgā .pe. tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati sukhassa ca pahānā .pe. catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati āsavānañca 1 khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati ime kho bhikkhave pañca phāsuvihārāti .
